list: Official 55 PS5 trophies: 1 Platinum, 2 Gold, 6 Silver, 46 Bronze. 28 are hidden on PSN until earned; 27 are visible from the start. All 55 are single-player.
notes: Names, descriptions and grades follow the PS5 trophy list. Hidden flags follow the PSN hidden set cross-checked across trophy databases (28 hidden, 27 visible). Guides below are written in original words; every specific location, count or unlock step is backed by the Sources line for that trophy. Where launch-week sources disagree or leave a trigger unconfirmed, the guide says so instead of guessing.

roadmap.title: Chapter 1 — first steps and the one missable window
roadmap.focus: Play the opening missions, keep a manual save at the start of the chapter, and do Lucia's balcony meditation the morning after Down to Earth before Chapter 1 ends. Meet Cal, try one arcade game at home, and start scanning vehicles and animals as you travel.
roadmap.window: MISSABLE WATCH: Positive Mental Attitude — the Chapter 1 balcony meditation disappears after Chapter 1. Whether the trophy strictly needs it was still unconfirmed in launch-week sources, so do it and keep the Chapter 1 save until the trophy pops. No mission replay exists, so keep one save per chapter.
roadmap.counts: Trophies in this stage: 5. Early counts that feed later stages: first meditation toward 18, first arcade completion, Cal's fishing chain opened.

roadmap.title: Chapters 2–3 — partner play, tools and robbery unlocks
roadmap.focus: Finish Chapters 2 and 3, unlock switching and calling your partner, and take optional jobs as they appear. Pick up the Scooter Bros app and garage buying in Chapter 2, then the Snap Gun, Key Cloner and Dye Pack Jammer in Chapter 3. Rob Kingpin Bowling with sticky bombs when it is marked.
roadmap.window: TIME-SENSITIVE (not a missable trophy by itself): Race Against Yago in Yago's Chapter 3 strand carries an hourglass icon and counts toward Strangers & Freaks — do it as soon as it appears and save first. Story trophies in this stage cannot be missed.
roadmap.counts: Trophies in this stage: 5. Unlocks that matter later: 8 garages to buy, 10 Scooter Bros registrations, jewelry-store stealth route, Randy's 16-car list, Tyrone's labs.

roadmap.title: Chapters 4–5 — finish the story, keep the pre-final save
roadmap.focus: Play through Chapter 4 into the final mission. Do the optional bank-vault introduction That's Where The Money Is when it appears so vault robberies open up. Keep one untouched manual save from just before the final mission.
roadmap.window: No trophy in this stage is missable and free roam continues after the credits, but there is no mission replay or New Game Plus — the pre-final save is your safety net. Cheats disable trophies and saving, so keep them off this save.
roadmap.counts: Trophies in this stage: 6, including the Gold for the final mission. After the credits the 100% checklist appears under Progress, Stats, 100% Completion; work done earlier already counts.

roadmap.title: The 100% checklist grind — A Long Road
roadmap.focus: Work the 35-line 100% checklist in free roam. It is forgiving — closer to 60% of everything in the game — but robberies, vaults, gang operations, shooting-range golds, drone races and Bret's decks must be done in full. Most collectible and activity trophies pop along the way.
roadmap.window: Nothing on the 100% checklist is missable in free roam. Do not stop at trophy counts: stunts need 300 for 100% (trophy at 250), challenges 70 of 80 (trophy at 50), vehicles 200 of 277 (trophy at 100).
roadmap.counts: Trophies in this stage: 15. Key totals: 300 stunts, 70 challenges, 200 vehicles scanned, 100 animals studied, 42 shooting golds, 42 drone races, 39 gang operations, 8 bank vaults, 100 WAiNK scans, 15 of 18 meditations for 100% (18 for the trophy).

roadmap.title: Side stories and partner cleanup
roadmap.focus: Finish the character questlines that each end in a trophy — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and Bret — plus 8 qualifying Strangers & Freaks strands. Bring your partner for the two wanted-level robberies, gym training and the remaining meditations.
roadmap.window: These questlines stay available after the story in launch-week sources; Kenton pauses after Chapter 1 and returns later, so a temporary disappearance is not a miss. Check the Strangers & Freaks counter after each strand, because only some strands count.
roadmap.counts: Trophies in this stage: 11. Strands that count include Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete; Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not count toward the 8.

roadmap.title: Money, miscellaneous feats and the Platinum
roadmap.focus: Spend and register your way through the money trophies, steal the jet and the tank, and mop up the small hidden feats. Avoid pushing the Criminal Profile to Irredeemable while farming Actions Speak Louder — that profile is permanent.
roadmap.window: PERMANENT WARNING (not a missable trophy): the Irredeemable Criminal Profile cannot be undone and makes police more aggressive. Two hidden triggers in this stage were still unconfirmed at launch; their guides label the lead as unconfirmed.
roadmap.counts: Trophies in this stage: 13, ending with Vice Got a Price! when the other 54 are earned. Money totals: spend $100,000, buy 8 garages for about $160,000, register 10 vehicles.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.window: Last trophy of the set. One playthrough is enough; there are no online, DLC or difficulty trophies.
trophies.guide: This Platinum appears automatically once every other trophy in the base list has been earned, so treat it as the finish line rather than a separate task. Plan on roughly 200 hours in total, with most of that time spent on the 100% checklist behind A Long Road. Work through the six roadmap stages in order and this will pop right after your final remaining trophy.

trophies.window: Automatic story trophy. It cannot be missed.
trophies.guide: Play the opening story mission Gone Fishing in Chapter 1 and the trophy unlocks as the mission ends. There is nothing extra to collect or choose here — simply follow the mission markers to the end. Keep a manual save from the start of Chapter 1 anyway, because the game offers no mission replay later.

trophies.guide: Finish every main mission in Chapter 1 and then start Chapter 2; the trophy is awarded once the first Chapter 2 mission, What's in the Bag?, is under way. Before you leave Chapter 1, accept Lucia's balcony meditation at Jason's house, because that optional moment is gone afterwards. No side content is required for this trophy itself.

trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 2 to its end and continue into Chapter 3; the trophy arrives as Chapter 3 begins, after Welcome to Vice City. trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 3 main missions and keep playing into Chapter 4; this trophy is awarded after the first two Chapter 4 missions, Ocean Beach and Another Life. Chapter 3 is also where the Snap Gun, Key Cloner and marked-bill laundering open up, so pick up those optional tools as they are offered. The trophy itself needs only story progress.

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4's main missions, ending with Starting From Zero, and the trophy unlocks with the chapter. During Chapter 4, do the optional mission That's Where The Money Is when it is marked, because it teaches bank-vault robberies needed for several later trophies. Keep an untouched save before the final mission that follows.

trophies.window: Automatic story trophy. Free roam continues after the credits; keep a pre-final manual save because missions cannot be replayed.
trophies.guide: Play the last story mission to the credits and this Gold trophy unlocks with the ending. How you play the mission does not matter — there are no mission medals to earn. Afterwards you return to free roam with everything else still available, and the 100% checklist becomes visible in the Progress menu.

trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 2 main mission Breakfast Run and the trophy unlocks during that mission. Shortly after this point in Chapter 2 you can switch between Jason and Lucia and call the other in as your partner, which is required for Hot Together, Retail Therapy and Personal Best. No optional objective inside the mission affects the trophy.

trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 4 main mission Child's Play and the trophy unlocks automatically. There is no choice or collectible inside the mission that changes whether it counts. Continue the chapter afterwards to reach the remaining Chapter 4 story trophies.

trophies.guide: Finish the Chapter 4 main mission VCIA Takedown and the trophy unlocks as part of the story. This is a scripted airport mission, separate from stealing a docked passenger jet in free roam for Catch Me If You Can. No optional step is required.

trophies.window: Automatic story trophy. It cannot be missed.
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 5 main mission Operation Savage Glory and the trophy is awarded automatically. It is one of the last named-mission trophies before the final mission. Keep your pre-final manual save untouched until the story is finished.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.window: Nothing on the checklist is missable; everything can be finished in free roam after the story. The checklist only becomes visible after the credits, but earlier progress counts.
trophies.guide: After the credits, open Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion and clear all 35 checklist lines. The list is forgiving — about 60% of everything in the game — so many lines need only part of a set, such as 200 of 277 vehicles, 100 of 255 animals, 70 of 80 challenges and 300 stunts. Lines that must be done in full include all robberies with 8 bank vaults and 39 gang operations, every shooting-range gold, all drone races and all 15 of Bret's Target Decks. Expect roughly 100 hours for this stage alone.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.window: Any mix of the four stunt types counts. Do not stop at 250 if you are chasing A Long Road, which needs 300.
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 stunts out of 397 in the world: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps, in any combination. Flying under bridges is generally the fastest way to build the count, and the optional challenge attached to each stunt is not required — performing the stunt once counts it. Track totals under Progress, Activities, Stunts, and keep going to 300 for the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.window: Most types are introduced by the story or marked as you unfog the map. Check Progress, Activities for what is left.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types at least once: fishing, hunting, golf, a shooting range, pool, basketball (sink one basket), an arcade game, winning a race, and performing a stunt. The race can be a car race, a race challenge or a Top Fun drone race. You will almost certainly cover all nine while working on other trophies, so check the Activities menu before grinding anything specifically for this.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.window: All 42 golds are also required in full for 100% Completion, so none can be skipped on the Platinum route.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in every Shooting Range challenge — 42 golds spread across 12 ranges. Work range by range and replay a challenge until its gold threshold is met; there is no shortcut that skips a medal. Shooting ranges also raise your Focus level, which makes Gunslinger easier later.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.window: One win per location earns the trophy, but 100% Completion wants all 42 drone races — finish each location while you are there.
trophies.guide: Win at least one Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 drone-race locations across Leonida. You do not need to win every race at a location for this trophy, only one per location. Since the 100% checklist requires all 42 drone races anyway, clear the remaining races at each spot before moving on to save a return trip.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.window: Winning the same race twice does not count. Keep a note of which races you have already won.
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races; there are 40 races to choose from, so you can skip the ones you dislike. Repeating a race you have already won adds nothing, which makes a simple written list of your wins worthwhile. Street races tied to Yago's strand are a natural place to start in Chapter 3.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.target: Beat Cal in his fishing challenge
trophies.window: Cal's chain opens in Chapter 1 after you meet him; his texts mark fishing spots with a purple icon.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, where you meet Cal, he texts you and marks a fishing spot on the map. Follow his fishing questline through its steps until his head-to-head challenge, then beat his catch to earn the trophy. Fishing also counts as one of the 9 activity types for Master of None.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.window: Three games are on the TV at home from Chapter 1; the fourth is on arcade cabinets in the world. All four are also needed for 100%.
trophies.guide: Reach the end of any one arcade game: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind are playable on the TV at home, while Bang For Your Buck is found on cabinets around Leonida. Completing means finishing all levels of that game once; its extra challenges are not required. Pick whichever game you enjoy most, then do the other three later for the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.window: Lucia-only chain that starts in Chapter 3 and stays available after the story.
trophies.guide: As Lucia in Chapter 3, take Andy's call and follow the address she texts you to Belville, then work through her five quests in order: Climbing the Cellerichain, Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass. Finishing the last one, Puff Puff Pass, awards the trophy. This chain does not count toward the 8 strands for Strangers & Freaks, so track it separately.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.window: Starts in Chapter 1; Kenton pauses after Chapter 1 and returns later by text. A temporary disappearance is not a miss.
trophies.guide: Meet Kenton at the green KR icon in Key Lento after the Chapter 1 mission Island Dreams, then dive at his purple chest markers and dig up each wreck's treasure with the metal detector before returning it to him. There are 7 shipwrecks in total across his sets of dives, tracked under Progress, Collections, Kenton's Treasures. If he vanishes after Chapter 1, keep playing — he texts Jason again later and the chain resumes.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.window: Opens after Coffee Break in Chapter 2 at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County; stays open after the story.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, head to the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County and run Billy's five jobs in order: Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler and Hometown Heroes. Completing Hometown Heroes, the fifth job, unlocks the trophy. Billy's chain has its own trophy and does not count toward Strangers & Freaks.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.window: Only some strands count. Do Race Against Yago promptly when it appears; check the trophy counter after each strand. Strands remain available after the story.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 qualifying stranger strands across Leonida. Confirmed counting strands include Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete, while the questlines for Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not count because they are not classed as strangers for this trophy. Because the full qualifying list was still being confirmed at launch, check the trophy's progress counter in your trophy list after finishing each strand instead of assuming it counted. None of these strands is required for 100% Completion.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.window: Opens after Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS in Chapter 3, which gives you the Key Cloner. Stays available after the story.
trophies.guide: After stealing the Zorrusso for Randy in Chapter 3, take his Wish List of 16 sports cars and deliver each one to his garage in west Vice City, marked RK. Scan high-end cars with the WAiNK app to check whether a car is on the list; hotel driveways around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach are reliable hunting grounds, and Randy marks some cars for you directly. Deliver cars in good condition for better pay, and the trophy follows the final delivery.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.target: Tyrone's final mission: Shut Down the Labs
trophies.window: Jason-only chain after Here, Kitty Kitty in Chapter 3; stays available after the story.
trophies.guide: Playing as Jason after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty, clear the synthetic labs Tyrone marks in purple around Vice City during Take Out Kitty Litter. Once enough labs are destroyed he offers the follow-up job Spin On This (Shut Down the Labs); finishing it awards the trophy. Lucia cannot take this chain, so switch to Jason before travelling to the markers.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.window: POTENTIALLY MISSABLE: the Chapter 1 balcony meditation at Jason's house is gone after Chapter 1. Launch-week sources had not confirmed whether the trophy needs it — do it anyway and keep a Chapter 1 save. The 100% checklist needs only 15 of 18, so A Long Road is not at risk.
trophies.guide: Meditate until the counter reaches 18 across the 10 meditation locations; meditating at a spot together with both Jason and Lucia counts twice, so bring your partner to every outdoor spot. The final meditation needs both characters playable together, which opens after Coffee Break in Chapter 2, and progress is tracked under Progress, Collections, Exploration, Meditations. Do not skip the first one: in Chapter 1, the morning after Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen, follow her to the balcony at Jason's house and accept her meditation before the chapter ends.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.target: Hunt Bret's unique animal (15 Target Decks for 100%)
trophies.window: Jason-only chain after Coffee Break in Chapter 2; stays available after the story. Which single animal triggers the trophy was still unconfirmed at launch.
trophies.guide: As Jason after Coffee Break in Chapter 2, answer Bret Vogel's text and meet him for Veteran Hunted in Lummox County to open his hunting chain. He then marks Target Deck hunts with purple icons; track the requested animal and bring it back to Bret — a clean one-shot kill keeps the carcass pristine and pays more, but is not required. Launch-week sources had not pinned down which exact animal pops the trophy, so simply work through his decks; all 15 are needed for 100% Completion anyway.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.window: Any 3 sets count; you do not need all 18. The Collections menu shows how close each set is.
trophies.guide: Complete any 3 Collectible Card sets out of the 18 sets in the game. Open Progress, then Collections, to see how many cards each set still needs and focus on the three sets closest to completion instead of hunting every card. Cards you find while clearing other 100% lines will usually finish a set or two on their own.
